report.ws.foot.wait: {sessions} sessions · {conversations} conversations · Avg. per conversation {avg} · Waiting for user {wait}
report.hour.aria: Hourly analysis: token output and human-message density
report.model.costNote: Cost is estimated from official public pricing (as of {asOf}; {covered}/{total} models have official pricing); only DeepSeek has official pricing.
report.model.costNote.total: Cost is estimated from official public pricing (as of {asOf}; {covered}/{total} models have official pricing · Total {totalCost}); only DeepSeek has official pricing.
report.footer.active: Active time = net active time (model + tool time, excluding {wait} waiting for user; cumulative, not wall clock).
report.footer.officialField: Official activeMs is kept in the API field {field} for verification: net active + waiting for user = official activeMs (conserved).
report.footer.wait: Waiting for user = intervals of interactive tools (ask_user_question / exit_plan_mode allowlist) or user/message events interleaved during a tool call, each ≥ 60s; long tasks without human input (builds / batch jobs) still count as work. The daily chart also uses net active time.
report.footer.hour: The hourly chart uses the Tokens basis by default: bars = tokens bucketed by assistant/message time (same basis as totals), dots = user/message count; turns are shown in the small chart below. Sessions whose event log cannot be read are excluded from tokens and counted below the chart.
report.footer.sessions: Conversations = sessions with steps; tokens come from the official projection; assigned by session creation date in {timeZone}.
report.footer.model: Model basis: one assistant/message = one request; the model comes from the event's provider/model; per-model time is split from session model time by streaming-window share (conserved).
report.footer.cost: Cost = estimated from official public pricing (DeepSeek peak/off-peak: peak 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays, off-peak at half price; Chinese statutory holidays are charged at peak rates, slightly overestimating), not an official bill.
report.footer.docs: Definitions: see docs/metrics.md in the repository. All data comes from this machine.
